candidate_reports.remark: Total snowfall since 8 am 5.2 inches. Liquid Eq: 0.89 inches.
Cocorahs reporter mentions first real snow of the season. Most melted as it landed. Elevation 799 ft.
Rain yesterday_ moderate intensity at times. Light rain_ mixing with a few snowflakes at obs time this morning. The snow liquid equivalent was also a Trace.

A cloudy day with the first snowfall of the season and a high of 35 F. The day presented a mix of rain and snow_ most of which melted on contact with the ground. Night skies remained cloudy and the temperature dipped to 32 F. Currently it is cloudy and 34 F with calm winds. The barometer is 29.82 inHg and steady. 0.43 inches in the gauge.
CoCoRaHS report: 0.25 inches of precipitation_ 34 degrees F_ cloudy.
Updates previous report. 4.3 inches of new snow between 10am and 5pm. Total 33 hour snowfall 9.5 inches. Snow depth 9 inches.
The Shemya AWOS recorded a wind gust of 75 mph at 1:55 pm.
